texts.preamble: Sushant Sharad Nakti vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2026 Digitally signed Aruna by Aruna Sandeep Sandeep Talwalkar Talwalkar Date: 2026.01.31 3.Apl126.202 18:37:54 +0530 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction Criminal Application No. 126 Of 2026 Sushant Sharad Nakti. ... Applicant. V/s. The State of Maharashtra. ... Respondents. --- Mr. Tuushar N. Sonawane, Advocate for Applicant. Psi D.D. Jadhav, Mangaon Police Station. --- Coram : Ashwin D. Bhobe, J. Date : 30th January, 2026. P.C. :
texts.arguments: 3. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court. He further submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Sushant Sharad Nakti vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22732124/ 1 Petition No. 4078 of 2025, Criminal Writ Petition No. 280 of 2025, and Criminal Writ Petition No. 3444 of 2025. He refers to the orders passed in the above said Application/Petition, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs. He submits that the issue involved in the present Application is subject matter of the Petitions referred by the Applicant in the present proceedings. He submits that the present Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (for short 'BNSS') be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions. 5. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the 3.APL126.2026.doc Applicant submits that the interim orders granted in the aforesaid three Petitions be also granted in this Application. Mr. Sukanta Karmakar, learned APP for the Respondent does not object to the said request.
